_readme: Every model and sound the game uses. 'file' is the path the game loads. Fill in 'source' (the exact NASA page URL) and 'credit' (the credit line that page gives) when you download. The game shows a marked placeholder for anything missing and logs it in the browser console. Downloaded 2026-11-14 from NASA 3D Resources (GitHub) and nasa.gov/historical-sounds. Sounds point at raw MP3s until prep-audio.sh exists.

insight.title: InSight lander
insight.credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech (NASA 3D Resources: "InSight Cruise Lander (arm deployed)"). Check it shows the landed lander.

apollo17-site.title: Apollo 17 Landing Site
apollo17-site.catalogName: Apollo 17 Landing Site (NASA has only a 3D-printing file, no .glb: TODO)
apollo17-site.note: Not used: NASA only has a 26 MB 3D-printing terrain file. The rover card uses the original LRV model.

voyager.fitNote: Framed by hand: most of this file's vertices are in the long magnetometer boom.
